executionPlan.policy: Milestones are dependency gates, not feature-name checklists. A downstream milestone may start in parallel only where it does not consume an unfinished contract.

milestones.nextAction: Maintain the separately named verification tiers and refresh the source-sealed capability receipt whenever a joined authority changes.
milestones.exit: Every required check has one owner and failure meaning; all live 1.0 work is assigned; local parity matches GitHub; no planning census masquerades as a product contract.

milestones.nextAction: Complete independent review and acceptance for pack capability/claim anchors, module registration/presentation, review compiler/map, longitudinal store, bot roster/route source, social play and casting; do not implement a draft contract early.
milestones.exit: Every shared schema, migration, evidence, module and persistence seam needed by 1.0 has an accepted RFC, an unambiguous register claim, and executable negative criteria.

milestones.nextAction: Finish the held semantic projections, capability/claim compatibility, complete-candidate packet, selectors, grade/review projections and the eleven registered learner modules; bind each producer to real module, bot and Review consumers.
milestones.exit: Collector to fact to selector to typed module/bot/Review is closed at runtime; every path can abstain; raw producer strings are inspector-only; content compatibility is computable before pack edits.

milestones.nextAction: Replace stacked board-column panels with one stable board region plus companion/drawer regions; finish preset composition and render evidence as typed components with touch, hover, focus and screen-reader parity.
milestones.exit: Quiet, Guided, Support, Drill, Review, Campaign, Academy and Stream open useful by default; the board never shrinks or moves; every primitive remains available under Advanced.

milestones.nextAction: Land migrations in register order: longitudinal jobs/observations, bot policy/roster state, campaign state, clocks/variants/social results; extend export, deletion, backup and rebuild with each object.
milestones.exit: Every workflow survives restart, retry, upgrade and projection rebuild with owner/actor identity, immutable inputs, idempotence, lifecycle coverage and no workstation-only state.

milestones.nextAction: Route principles/theory, longitudinal/profile, registered opponents, campaign, native/social/clocks and professional verbs through createApplication with typed auth, errors, availability and release-container tests.
milestones.exit: No feature is declared live from a direct REST handler alone; every advertised family crosses the production application and release-image boundary.

milestones.nextAction: Ship full vertical journeys for arrival/rehearsal, whole-game Review/return, theory/library, human-like bots/history, profile/style/skills, campaign, human play, coach/classroom/stream and account lifecycle; close their UX items by observed behavior, not component presence.
milestones.exit: Every route has opinionated defaults, loading/empty/error/recovery, responsive and accessible behavior, return doors, and no raw enum/JSON/cp or settings-first workflow.

milestones.nextAction: Reground theory and principles, refresh manifests, graduate a varied pilot, then author the opening/middlegame/endgame/training-form/campaign/bot/Review matrix against stable capability declarations.
milestones.exit: The release contains an allow-listed official corpus exercising every important handshake, counter-case, honest-empty state and complete campaign without blind mass rewrites.

milestones.nextAction: Exercise the ten release journeys against digest-pinned images on clean hosts, including provider-off degradation, migration, backup/restore, update/rollback, accessibility, rights/SBOM and owner-device use.
milestones.exit: Every core and breadth capability proves all applicable completion dimensions or has an explicit owner-approved descope; the owner can use the release without interpreting implementation vocabulary.
